prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: side impact at intersection in Houston, Texas. Injury: knee injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1104; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving through a four-way intersection in Houston, Texas, with a green light when a vehicle coming from my left ran its red signal and struck the driver's side of my car. The impact pushed my car sideways and I felt my right knee hit the door frame hard. I stayed at the scene until the police arrived, and I gave the same description of what happened to the officer, to the adjuster, and to the medical staff who treated me: the other vehicle entered the intersection against the light. I am the named driver on this policy and I was the only person in my car at the time. My knee swelled within hours and I was unable to bear weight for several days. I am submitting this account for the claim and am willing to provide any further records requested.
